يلتقطوا (form VIII)
# يَلْتَقِطُوا (yaltaqiṭū) /jal.ta.qi.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# يُلْتَقَطُوا (yultaqaṭū) /jul.ta.qa.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
